card.name: Words in quotes and book titles
card.fires_on: Scattered words inside quoted passages, book titles and famous sayings, such as 'Great' after 'The' or 'world' in 'people of the world'. The words themselves vary.

modes.label: Great in titles
modes.description: The word Great (or the word before it) in a book title or historical phrase.
modes.example: I was born in the<< Great>> Depression, but didn’t feel deprived,

modes.label: Quoted sayings
modes.description: Words inside a quoted saying or speech about the world or life.
modes.example: More than half the people of the<< world>> are living in conditions approaching misery
